tagline.en: Coinflip now tosses a minted gold-and-silver coin.
tagline.id: Coinflip sekarang melempar koin cetak emas-perak.

items.en: Coinflip: new coin with a reeded rim, engraved lettering, a crown on heads and a star on tails, and a visible edge while it spins.
items.id: Coinflip: koin baru dengan pinggiran bergerigi, tulisan timbul, mahkota di heads dan bintang di tails, serta sisi koin terlihat saat berputar.
